channel.title: Evgeniy Tsvetkov
channel.description: Notes on product, tech, and growing as a person.

item.title: You Curate Context for AI. What About Your Own Brain?
item.description: You carefully curate context for AI. But what are you feeding your own neural networks? Reels and cheap dopamine? The hypocrisy is almost impressive.

item.title: It's Not AI. It's Overproduction.
item.description: People want AI content labeled. But the real issue isn't AI — it's overproduction. Every time content gets cheaper to make, the same thing happens.

item.title: AI FOMO Is Real. And You Already Have It.
item.description: First it was curiosity. Then excitement. Now it's low-grade anxiety. The world is speeding up, and while you sleep, someone out there just found three more ways to use AI.

item.title: SaaS Isn't Dying. It's Becoming Alive.
item.description: Old SaaS was one product for everyone plus a settings page. New SaaS is a base platform with thousands of personal layers built by AI agents. Software stops being a product and becomes a process.

item.title: You're Not Competing With Founders Anymore
item.description: Being a founder in 2026 means running a zoo of AI agents that half-work, fully panic you, and never clock out. The race stopped being human — and your only real job now is figuring out how to stay sane while the swarm does its thing.

item.title: Nobody Will Visit Your Website. And That's the Point.
item.description: We're not heading toward a redesign. We're heading toward the death of the interface itself. When AI agents do the browsing, your pretty landing page won't matter.

item.title: Simplicity is the New F*ck-You to Complexity
item.description: In a world drowning in over-engineered crap, simplicity wins — from command-line tools to Toyota's Land Cruiser 70.

item.title: Doing the Thing Is Doing the Thing
item.description: I stumbled upon a tiny essay that feels like the most honest productivity advice I've read in years. No hacks. No systems. No mindset gymnastics. Just one blunt, repeating idea that quietly destroys procrastination by refusing to negotiate with it.

item.title: Your Brain Invents Complexity
item.description: Mark Manson on why emotionally hard problems feel complex — and why the brain invents complexity to avoid action.

item.title: B2B Is Not About Bigger Money. It's About a Better Environment.
item.description: B2B Is Not About Bigger Money. It's About a Better Environment. Why B2B creates a more comfortable ecosystem for finding your first true fans and evolving a product.

item.title: Memes can be mirrors — or megaphones.
item.description: Memes can be mirrors — or megaphones. How Duolingo turned a simple retention mechanic into one of the most recognizable marketing memes.

item.title: Some memes are just jokes. Others are product ideas waiting to happen.
item.description: Some memes are just jokes. Others are product ideas waiting to happen. How Loom turned collective meeting exhaustion into a product.
